problem: Fix the passive-tree atom-source defect P11.1r: TreeAtomSource filters every stat.modify atom while NodeAtom calls that kind primary, so stat.modify contributions never reach the composed node.
notes: MERGED 2026-09-25 at d6b3b3dd (artifact resume-33-p11-1r-20260925-d6b3b3dd.json). The LANE BLOCKED with evidence; the manager accepted its in-fence half (documentation + 5 contract tests) and left P11.1r open for an owner design decision. Use the existing AtomDerivedSubsystem fan-in; do not add a fourth IActorStatSubsystem. Read spec-mechanism-wiring.md. No data/seed, data/generated, tuning, or generator corpus edits. outcome: BLOCKED 2026-09-25 (resume-33). The required behaviour is not reachable through the existing AtomDerivedSubsystem fan-in, and this is now measured rather than asserted. Three independent bars, each pinned by a test against the real classes: (1) CHANNEL VOCABULARY - stat.modify's channel param is declared against AtomKindRegistry.PrimaryChannels (StatChannels.All) and the committed corpus names only atk/defense, while DerivedComposer.Compose calls DerivedStatRegistry.ValidateChannel on every modifier and THROWS UnknownDerivedChannelException on a non-derived id, so widening the kind filter is a per-hit throw on the lawn, not a no-op; (2) OPS - stat.modify is Flat|Increased|More and DerivedModifierOp has no More, which AtomDerivedSubsystem.TryParseOp refuses by name; (3) LIFE CYCLE - stat.modify is the one kind with TriggerOptional: true, composing per fire through a sourced primary ledger, where a once-resolved BoundDerivedAtom cannot follow it. A primary carrier is a new type on the primary half of the stat system (StatSystem session bag or an IStatModifierPlugin for the lawn; the primary battle ledger in battle) and a reviewed decisions.md row - all outside this fence, which is the brief's named stop condition. INDEPENDENT CORROBORATION, pre-existing at HEAD: tests/FusionRpg.Server.Tests/PassiveTreeEndpointsTests.Post_anOwnedTierOneNodeAfterOpeningTierOne_contributes is RED, and it is red for exactly this reason - the shared TreeJson() fixture's node atom is deliberately stat.modify/atk (that file's own comment at :488 calls it 'an ignored kind on this projection, per TreeAtomSource.BoundAtomsFor's own magnitude-class only gate'), so the node is correctly not in ContributingNodeIds. That test will go green the day a primary carrier lands and no edit inside TreeAtomSource can turn it green. Landed in fence instead: the correction of the factually wrong NodeAtomOpToWireString More comment (it claimed the mapping is only reached for stat.derived, which is false - More is a real stat.modify op refused only by the kind filter), the three measured bars documented on TryReadOp, and 5 contract tests including the falsifier and the P11.1r report/read parity pair. Behaviour unchanged: the filter is exactly where it was (executable diff on TreeAtomSource.cs is empty), a stat.modify atom still contributes nothing and is still reported as non-contributing.
